title: Build/DAG sub-tab pure renderer
description: Pure HTML-string renderer for the Build tab's DAG sub-tab: `buildDagLayout(fbsItems, buildableIds)` projects `dependsOnFbsIds` into depth columns, `buildOrder` row ordering, upstream/downstream closures, longest-chain critical path and the no-in-no-out unconnected lane; `renderBuildDag({ layout, inspectorPayload })` emits the toolbar, canvas (HTML button nodes + inline SVG edges with cubic paths and arrowheads) and inspector shell. `buildDagInspectorPayload(layout)` builds the one-row-per-FBS payload (status, area, size, order, AC count, direct and transitive needs/waits, meta) that rides on the inspector shell as `data-rcf-dag-inspector-data` per the PR 1 contract. Cycles are excluded from the depth layout and surfaced as `cycleIds` for the toolbar finding (AC-204-6); the renderer never emits a `postMessage` call (AC-204-7).
